#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;
const int MAXN = 1 << 20;
double cs[MAXN], sn[MAXN], csi[MAXN], sni[MAXN];

void init_fft_tables() {
    for (int len = 1; len <= MAXN; len <<= 1) {
        for (int i = len / 2; i < len; i++) {
            cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
            sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
            csi[i] = cos(-2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
            sni[i] = sin(-2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
        }
    }
}

void fft(vector<double>& a, vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
    int n = a.size();
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        for (; j & bit; bit >>= 1) j ^= bit;
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(a[i], a[j]);
            swap(b[i], b[j]);
        }
    }
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int halfLen = len >> 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            int w = MAXN / len;
            for (int j = 0, k = 0; j < halfLen; j++, k += w) {
                double wA = inverse ? csi[halfLen + j] : cs[halfLen + j];
                double wB = inverse ? sni[halfLen + j] : sn[halfLen + j];
                double uA = a[i + j];
                double uB = b[i + j];
                double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
            }
        }
    }
    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] /= n;
            b[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}

vector<int> multiplyMod(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = 1;
    while (n < need) n <<= 1;
    if (n < 2) n = 2;

    vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0), aImaginary(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        aImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(aReal, aImaginary, false);

    vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0), bImaginary(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
        bImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    fft(bReal, bImaginary, false);

    vector<double> faReal(n), faImaginary(n), fbReal(n), fbImaginary(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
        double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
        double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) / 2;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

        faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        faImaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;

        fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
        fbImaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
    }

    fft(faReal, faImaginary, true);
    fft(fbReal, fbImaginary, true);

    vector<int> res(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long bb = (long long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
        long long cc = (long long)(faImaginary[i] + 0.5);
        long long term = aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30);
        res[i] = (int)(term % mod);
    }
    return res;
}

class InputReader {
    FILE* is;
    char buf[1024];
    int pos, size;
public:
    InputReader(FILE* is) : is(is), pos(0), size(0) {}
    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c)) c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') { sign = -1; c = read(); }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("InputMismatch");
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }
    int read() {
        if (size == -1) throw runtime_error("InputMismatch");
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            size = fread(buf, 1, 1024, is);
            if (size <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++] & 0xFF;
    }
    static bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

class PrintWriter {
    FILE* out;
public:
    PrintWriter(FILE* out) : out(out) {}
    void println(int x) { fprintf(out, "%d\n", x); }
    void close() { fflush(out); }
};

struct TaskG {
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, PrintWriter& out) {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int k = in.nextInt();
        vector<int> v(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = in.nextInt();
            v[x] = 1;
        }
        vector<int> ans = {1};
        int p = n / 2;
        while (true) {
            if (p % 2 != 0) {
                ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, MOD);
            }
            p /= 2;
            if (p == 0) break;
            v = multiplyMod(v, v, MOD);
        }
        int res = 0;
        for (int x : ans) {
            res = (int)((res + (long long)x * x) % MOD);
        }
        out.println(res);
    }
};

int main() {
    init_fft_tables();
    InputReader in(stdin);
    PrintWriter out(stdout);
    TaskG solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    out.close();
    return 0;
}
